{{Quote|They do have Leth's new ''war droids'' in production, sir&mdash;the SD-10s.''"<br />"''I ''know'', Mordi. I need those droids to smash the ''Rebels''&hellip;that's why I don't simply ''wipe out'' Beltane&hellip;and his planet!|Krdys Mordi and Sedriss QL, during the Battle of Balmorra|<ref name="DE II 1" />}}
'''Krdys Mordi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who served the [[Essence transfer|reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as part of his selected cadre of [[darksider]]s, the [[Dark Side Elite]]. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], after the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|second death]], Mordi participated in the [[Dark Empire|Imperial]] offensive called [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. During that campaign, he accompanied the leader of the Dark Side Elite, [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]], in the [[Battle of Balmorra|failed subjugation effort]] of the rebellious [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

When the Emperor returned in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body again, Mordi led a [[Battle of New Alderaan (Operation Shadow Hand)|mission]] to the planet [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] with the goal of abducting [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jaina Solo Fel|twin]] [[Darth Caedus|children]] of his sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Alongside Palpatine's second-in-command, [[Tedryn-Sha]], Mordi tried to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] Skywalker and capture him in his [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]], but Leia Organa and the young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Jem Ysanna]] supported their fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In the ensuing confrontation, Mordi was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Ysanna, who [[Sai tok/Legends|bisected]] him with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
===Extension of Palpatine's will===
Krdys Mordi was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="DE II 1" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DE II 6" /> [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in service to the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="DE II 1" /> who was [[Essence transfer|reborn]] in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body after his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="DE II 1" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The reincarnated [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] ruled his clandestine [[Dark Empire]]&mdash;the latest incarnation of the once-dominant [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Mordi became a member of Palpatine's [[Dark Side Elite]], a group of seven Dark Jedi empowered with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by the Emperor himself.<ref name="DE II 1" />

[[File:Palpatineeclipse.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The reborn Emperor Palpatine's death at Pinnacle Base]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]], which features [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] over [[Pinnacle Base]], to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Palpatine died again during a [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|battle]] with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] siblings [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], near the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Pinnacle Base]].<ref name="DE 6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref> In the aftermath of Palpatine's death, the leader of the Dark Side Elite, [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]], took command of the Imperial forces and oversaw [[Operation Shadow Hand]], a series of strikes intending to place neutral planets under firm Imperial rule.<ref name="DE II 1" />

===Operation Shadow Hand===
{{Quote|The fool has thrown ''everything'' at us. The ''trap'' is sprung&mdash;! Pull back the troops, Mordi.''"<br />"Gladly'', Sedriss.|Sedriss QL and Krdys Mordi, during the Battle of Balmorra|<ref name="DE II 1" />}}
One of the targets of Sedriss's campaign was the [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. After the death of the Emperor, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Hinch Beltane]] of Balmorra had started supplying the New Republic with [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], an arrangement that Sedriss was determined to end.<ref name="DE II 1" /> As one of Sedriss's sergeants-at-arms,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|330|Mordi, Krdys}}</ref> Mordi, alongside fellow Dark Jedi [[Vill Goir]], accompanied the Executor to Balmorra aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], joining an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] already assembled in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet.<ref name="DE II 1" />

[[File:ImperialHaggling-DEII1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Krdys Mordi (left) witnesses Sedriss QL contact Governor Beltane during the Battle of Balmorra.]]
Upon the group's arrival, Sedriss offered Beltane a chance to surrender his operations to the Empire and face execution, lest the Empire launch a full-scale invasion of the planet. Beltane did not heed Sedriss's threats, believing that Sedriss would not dare risk damaging Balmorran [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in a direct assault, as they still produced weaponry for the Empire as well. Mordi concurred with Beltane's point of view, reminding Sedriss that Balmorran factories were currently manufacturing the new [[SD-10 battle droid]] model, which were meant to replace the Empire's outdated [[SD-9 battle droid|SD-9 model]].<ref name="DE II 1" />

However, Sedriss had formulated a plan that would allow him to conquer the planet without damaging the factories. As such, he proceeded with the attack, [[Battle of Balmorra|launching]] ground [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]. When Balmorran [[Droid/Legends|droids]] fully engaged Sedriss's invasion troops and were drawn from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Bin Prime]], to the open plains surrounding it, the Executor ordered Mordi to pull back the Empire's forces and launched his secret weapon, the new highly advanced [[Shadow Droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="DE II 1" />

The Shadow Droids temporarily turned the tide of the battle in favor of the Empire. However, Beltane had a trick of his own, deploying the newly developed [[X-1 Viper]] Automadons at the invasion force. Amazed at the firepower of Beltane's creation, Sedriss contacted the governor and acknowledged his victory. Mordi and Goir disagreed with that decision, believing that Sedriss should have simply ordered his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to initiate an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the planet. However, Sedriss wanted to obtain the X-1 droids for himself before attempting any punishing actions against Beltane, and he negotiated a treaty with the governor, granting Balmorra freedom and purchasing a number of X-1 Vipers from him.<ref name="DE II 1" />

===Abduction of Skywalker===
{{Quote|The poison will work quickly. ''Take him,'' Mordi!''"<br />"''Yes, Tedryn!|Tedryn-Sha and Krdys Mordi, trying to capture Luke Skywalker|<ref name="DE II 6" />}}
Shortly after the Battle of Balmorra, Palpatine was resurrected on Byss in his final available clone body.<ref name="DE II 1" /> He took control of the Empire once again and successfully [[Destruction of Da Soocha V|destroyed]] the New Republic's Pinnacle Base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Da Soocha V]] with his new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Galaxy Gun]].<ref name="DE II 5">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref> The New Republic was forced to retreat to a secret [[Safe world|sanctuary world]], where Organa Solo was hiding her [[Jaina Solo Fel|twin]] [[Darth Caedus|children]], whom the Emperor wanted to capture and turn to the dark side.<ref name="DE II 6" />

The Emperor soon learned the name of the hidden planet, [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], as well as its coordinates, from the captured New Republic [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Ntthan]]. Palpatine then sent the Dark Side Elite there under the command of [[Xecr Nist]], his newly appointed Executor. Nist was a replacement for Sedriss,<ref name="DE II 6" /> who had recently been [[Skirmish on Ossus|killed in battle]] with Skywalker.<ref name="DE II 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref> Mordi and the other [[darksider]]s boarded their [[I-7 Howlrunner]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and departed from their headquarters of [[Bast Castle]] on the planet [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]<ref name="DE II 6" /> as [[Dark Side Squadron]]. Upon [[Battle of New Alderaan (Operation Shadow Hand)|arrival]] on New Alderaan, the Dark Side Elite split up. Nist took four Dark Jedi with him and went to abduct the Solo [[Twin/Legends|twins]] while Mordi was dispatched alongside Palpatine's second-in-command, [[Tedryn-Sha]], to confront Skywalker himself.<ref name="DE audio" />

[[File:Mordi.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mordi hunts his Jedi targets on New Alderaan.]]
Mordi and Sha were instructed to incapacitate the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] with specialized [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid|scarab droids]] while he was [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]] so that he could be taken captive.<ref name="DE audio" /> [[Force stealth|Hiding their presence]] from the sleeping Jedi with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the two darksiders reached his room and released the scarab droids upon Skywalker through a [[Window/Legends|window]]. The droids administered a powerful [[Poison/Legends|poison]] into the Jedi's nervous system, and the two Dark Jedi entered the room to capture Skywalker. However, in his delirium, Skywalker let out a loud scream, which alerted his sister Leia and one of Skywalker's [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|aspiring Jedi]], [[Jem Ysanna]]. The two women rushed to Skywalker's help, and Ysanna immediately killed Mordi by [[Sai tok/Legends|slicing him across the torso]] with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Sha killed her in response with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot but was himself slain by Organa Solo with a lightsaber strike. Mordi and Sha's incursion was ultimately a failure, as Skywalker was healed from the effects of the poison by the elderly Jedi [[Vima-Da-Boda]].<ref name="DE II 6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|By the dark side, Tedryn&mdash;''more Jedi!'' But they are only ''women!''<s></s>|Krdys Mordi|<ref name="DE II 6" />}}
[[File:Mordi_killed.jpg|thumb|right|235px|Krdys Mordi underestimated the combat prowess of Jedi women, such as Jem Ysanna, resulting in his death.]]
Krdys Mordi was a Dark Jedi loyal to Palpatine and his Dark Empire. During the Battle of Balmorra, Mordi initially advised Sedriss QL against launching an invasion of the planet, afraid of damaging Balmorra's factories, which were producing the much-needed Imperial SD-10 droids. However, as Balmorra's Governor Beltane continued to show defiance, Mordi expressed an opinion that Sedriss needed to bombard the planet to show the governor the error of his ways.<ref name="DE II 1" />

On New Alderaan, Mordi was initially not impressed with Luke Skywalker after seeing him asleep, believing that the Jedi posed no threat in that state.<ref name="DE audio" /> He later underestimated Jem Ysanna and Leia Organa Solo as well, based on the single fact that they were women&mdash;a mistake that led to his demise. The Dark Jedi had light skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that glowed [[Color/Legends|yellow]].<ref name="DE II 6" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|They masked their thoughts&hellip;I never sensed their approach!|Luke Skywalker, on Krdys Mordi and Tedryn-Sha|<ref name="DE II 6" />}}
Mordi was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who was empowered with the dark side by Palpatine himself, becoming a Dark Jedi.<ref name="DE II 1" /> He could hide his presence in the Force, which allowed him to sneak up on Luke Skywalker undetected on New Alderaan. Mordi flew an I-7 Howlrunner<ref name="DE II 6" /> as part of Dark Side Squadron.<ref name="DE audio" />

==Equipment==
During his service to Palpatine, Mordi was dressed in an [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] similar to his cohorts in the Dark Side Elite, wearing a dark [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with a long [[Cape/Legends|cape]] and a hood that covered his head, as well as massive [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]]. During the Battle of Balmorra, he also wore [[Spectacles|glasses]] and carried a [[Staff/Legends|staff]].<ref name="DE II 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tomveitch.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tom Veitch, the author of ''Dark Empire II'' 1]]
The Dark Jedi Mordi first appeared in the [[Dark Empire II 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]'', written by [[Tom Veitch]], illustrated by [[Cam Kennedy]],<ref name="DE II 1" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 20]], [[1994]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54063/star_wars_dark_empire_ii_1994_1|text=Star Wars: Dark Empire II (1994) #1}}</ref> On [[May 23]], [[1995]],<ref name="Marvel Dark Empire II 6">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54068/star_wars_dark_empire_ii_1994_6|text=Star Wars: Dark Empire II (1994) #6}}</ref> the character returned in the [[Dark Empire II 6|final issue]] of ''Dark Empire'', in which he was provided with the first name "Krdys" and was killed off.<ref name="DE II 6" /> Mordi was originally set to debut in Veitch's proposed short novel, [[Lightsider (story)|''Lightsider'']], which would have taken place before ''Dark Empire II'' and would have introduced the Dark Side Elite. However, ''Lightsider'' was never published.<ref name="ComicScan">{{CollectorCite|4|ComicScan|ComicScan: Comics That Almost Were}}</ref>

In the 1995 [[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]], Mordi is absent during the invasion of Balmorra scenes, with Vill Goir serving as Sedriss's sole advisor. Mordi does appear in the audio drama during the events on New Alderaan, and he has a brief exchange of dialogue with Jem Ysanna, challenging her to a fight.<ref name="DE audio" /> In the original comic, Mordi is killed immediately after the Jedi women rush to Skywalker's aid, with no dialogue spoken between them.<ref name="DE II 6" /> [[2000]]'s comic guide [[Star Wars Handbook 3: Dark Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 3: ''Dark Empire'']], written by [[Peet Janes]], states that Mordi underwent the initiation into the Dark Side Elite alongside Xecr Nist. This contradicts<ref name="Handbook">[[Star Wars Handbook 3: Dark Empire|''Star Wars Handbook'' 3: ''Dark Empire'']]</ref> the [[March 21]], 1995<ref name="Marvel Dark Empire II 4">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54066/star_wars_dark_empire_ii_1994_4|text=Star Wars: Dark Empire II (1994) #4}}</ref> [[Dark Empire II 4|fourth issue]] of the ''Dark Empire II'' comic series, which features Tedryn-Sha as the other subject of the initiation beside Nist,<ref name="DE II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref> while ''Dark Empire II'' 1 shows that Mordi had already been a member of the group by that point.<ref name="DE II 1" />
